narr: Several rounds of heavy rain across southeast Arkansas produced flooding.
ev: Streets in town were flooded, and floodwaters approached or entered several of the businesses along US Highway 65.

A quick burst of heavy rainfall caused flooding along a creek where it passed under Ashley 12 Road near the intersection with Ashley 283 Road. Video from the area showed two to three feet of water rushing over the roadway.
lsr: Video from emergency manager shows 2-3 feet of rushing water over Ashley 12 Road near Big Brushy Creek. The road was closed due to high water.
Videos and photos from the Eudora area showed floodwaters approaching or entering several businesses along US Highway 65. Other city streets were flooded. Flooding began between 1 to 2 pm.
